verdict.rationale: Stable's marketing describes background automations for mail: keyword-based auto-routing to teams, an AI-powered inbox that sorts and routes mail automatically, automated check deposits, and configurable Slack/email alerts. Webhooks also let users trigger their own external automations on account events. These are fixed, domain-specific automations described only on marketing pages rather than a general automation builder. Missing for 10: documented rule/automation configuration (triggers, conditions, actions), general-purpose or scheduled workflows beyond mail handling, agent-driven autonomous actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
